evd_title: LLMs performed suboptimally identifying placebo arm suitability and risk mitigation in single prompt
finding: LLMs performed suboptimally identifying placebo arm suitability and risk mitigation in single prompt
P: 7 health research ethics case studies (FERCAP-SIDCER handbook), 28 LLM-case cells per condition
I: Google Bard, ChatGPT 3.5, Claude-Instant-100k, ChatGPT 4.0; single prompt vs multiple prompts (one query at a time)
C: Single vs multiple prompting (within-LLM); expected key responses, 2 author raters with consensus
O: Qualitative: single prompt suboptimal on placebo-arm suitability, risk mitigation, participant risks; multi-prompt better; no stats test
T: LLMs queried Oct-Nov 2023; FERCAP-SIDCER handbook 2012; paper 2025
